## Abstract

The Application Architecture domain encompasses decisions related to software application design, development standards, technology stack choices, deployment patterns, and application lifecycle management. This domain focuses on ensuring applications are built with consistency, maintainability, scalability, and alignment with enterprise standards.

Application architecture decisions directly impact development velocity, system maintainability, security posture, and operational efficiency across the organization's software portfolio.
